name: pm-kit
description: Claude Code skills for project-board management with Fraction hygiene applied at the point of writing: create a single card correctly (INBOX vs BACKLOG, Feature, standard custom fields, duplicate check, source attribution), post correctly-formatted comments, bootstrap a new Asana project to standard, audit and fix an existing Asana board. Ships a first-party Asana MCP server. Use for "add a ticket", "log a bug", "track this", "clean up the board", "asana hygiene", "enrich the backlog", "create an Asana project".
